boundaries.name: proof_verification
boundaries.obligation: `builder.verify_proof` of both balance proofs under the shared verifier data is the acceptance premise `proofAccepted`; plonky2 soundness, the balance verifier key and recursion correctness are not proved.

boundaries.name: sub_gadget_acceptance
boundaries.obligation: `AccountStateTarget::new`, `TxSettlementTarget::new` (tx Merkle opening, spend-proof verification, `tx.connect(spend_pis.tx)`) and `TransferWitnessTarget::new` (transfer-leaf opening incl. aux_data) are opaque acceptance premises; Merkle soundness is not proved.

boundaries.name: spend_pis_projection
boundaries.obligation: The target `spend_pis()` wire projection (`spendPisTarget`, total) and the native `spend_pis()` parse (`spendPis`, may fail) are opaque; agreement between them is a premise of `target_witness_of_native_success`.

boundaries.name: recipient_hash
boundaries.obligation: `calculate_recipient_from_user_id(_circuit)` (Poseidon + tag byte) is the opaque `recipientOf`; no injectivity or salt-hiding property is proved.

boundaries.name: nullifier_hash
boundaries.obligation: `SettledTransfer::nullifier` (Poseidon over the 28-word preimage) is the opaque `nullifierOf`; hash injectivity and nullifier freshness (no double credit) are not proved, only the preimage layout injectivity.

boundaries.name: keccak_chain_push
boundaries.obligation: `settled_tx_chain_push(_circuit)` is the opaque `keccak` over the 17-word domain/chain/aux preimage; no collision or semantic property of aux_data (tx leaf hash) is proved.

boundaries.name: imported_gadget_interfaces
boundaries.obligation: The public-state Merkle root call, asset-tree root and nullifier-insertion gadget are the imported `UpdatePublicState`/`UpdatePrivateState` interfaces (`getRoot`, `assetRoot`, `nullifierCall`); their tree semantics are premises of those modules.

boundaries.name: field_and_gadget_lowering
boundaries.obligation: `enforce_ge`, `conditional_ge`, `conditional_gt`, `is_zero`, `not`, `select`, `assert_one`, `connect` and the u63/u32 checked allocations are read as integer relations on Nat; the field encoding and plonky2 gate lowering are not refined.

boundaries.name: native_field_conversion
boundaries.obligation: `to_u64_vec` and `ToField::to_field_vec` on the verifier-data suffix are the opaque `convertFields`; canonical field/word conversion is not modeled.

boundaries.name: witness_write_and_proving
boundaries.obligation: `set_witness` and `data.prove` are modeled as a write order and an opaque `prover`; that the written witness satisfies the constraints (and only then) is not proved.

boundaries.name: compiler_refinement
boundaries.obligation: The Lean structures are a handwritten reading of the Rust; no refinement between the model and the compiled plonky2 constraint system or the native binary is proved.
